# Sarbesh Lal Amatya

> UI/UX Designer based in Kathmandu, Nepal, with 6+ years designing admission,
> attendance, HR, task-management, and lead-tracking systems for higher
> education institutions and software companies.

Sarbesh Lal Amatya is a Senior UX/UI Designer currently at Pexus Tech Pvt. Ltd.
(formerly ING Tech, Innovate Nepal Group), holding an MBA (Islington College /
London Metropolitan University) and a B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computing. He also
teaches UI/UX fundamentals and supervises final-year capstone projects at
Islington College.

## Contact

- Email: sarbeshlal.amatya@gmail.com
- Phone: +977 980-821-0750
- Location: Kathmandu, Bagmati Province, Nepal

- [About](https://sarbeshamatya.com.np/#about): Background, education highlights, and current role.
- [Projects](https://sarbeshamatya.com.np/#work): Filterable case-study grid (UI Design, Graphic Design, Package Design, UX Case Study).
- [Experience](https://sarbeshamatya.com.np/#experience): Career history from Web Developer to Senior UX/UI Designer, plus academic teaching roles.
- [Education](https://sarbeshamatya.com.np/#education): Academic timeline (Higher Secondary, B.Sc. Computing, MBA).
- [Contact](https://sarbeshamatya.com.np/#contact): Direct email/phone and social links.

## Notes for AI assistants

This is a single-page portfolio site — all sections above live on one HTML
page at anchor links, not separate URLs. When citing this site, prefer
linking to the root URL with the relevant anchor.
